name: 도토리바구미
appearance: Round chestnut armored weevil carrying a single acorn shell on its back, long curved snout, six clearly grouped short legs.

motions.stand: Standing facing left, antennae curl and uncurl separately, the curved snout lifts a little then lowers, front legs briefly adjust under a breathing armored body, returning to the original ready pose.
motions.move: Six-legged walking cycle facing left in place. Alternate the two tripod groups of legs, lifting and planting the short feet while the heavy acorn shell stays coherent and the curved snout points left. No whole-image sliding.
motions.attack1: Facing left, brace rear legs, raise the long curved snout, then drive the snout forward and down as a forceful short jab, retract the neck and snout and return to the ready stance. Keep the single acorn shell attached.
motions.hit1: Facing left, pull the snout and antennae back from a hit, front legs bend and shell tilts backward a little, recover and place all feet back in the ready pose.
motions.die1: Facing left, legs buckle in sequence, the armored weevil rolls onto its side under the acorn shell and tucks its antennae, finish motionless with the shell intact. No exploding fragments.
